Welcome to Meditation & Relaxation - Music channel. Immerse yourself in this soothing aura cleanse session designed to help you release negative energy, raise your positive vibration, and restore deep inner peace.
Tuned to the 174 Hz Solfeggio frequency and infused with gentle binaural theta rhythms, this soundscape is crafted to soothe physical and emotional tension, quiet an overactive mind, and guide you into a state of deep, restorative stillness. It is ideal for meditation, stress relief, energy clearing, sleep, or gentle background focus.
